label: Thin and act readings of perfection of being on one subsistent source: controls
paraphrase: Closed finite profiles; statements about them only. A source that is its own being and a living effect; two stipulated pure determinations, one standing for being and one, a Boolean stand-in for life (not any recorded sense of LIVING). Thin profile: only being is a perfection of being and the source has only being; d164b1ff holds, c4fb87a6 fails at the stand-in for life, and the source lacks it. Act profile: every pure determination is a perfection of being and the source has every determination; both premises and their composite hold. It witnesses where a thin reading of 'perfection of being' leaves the pair: it can keep d164b1ff and must give up c4fb87a6. It is not evidence for either reading.
